posts.title: System Review: Havoc Brigade
posts.description: Havoc Brigade I love this game. posts.title: My 2026 Q1 Games
posts.description: Over the last few years at work we've shifted into tracking work on a quarterly basis. Hardly revolutionary for many workplaces, but it was a shift in thinking for me. I've slowly taken a liking to it.
